data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher20/22, help recruit. Assuming k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but costs8 remaining and16 next-stock tons in the low outcome. Even k=25 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Long-run gains aren't assured.
